title: Add, remove, replace: arrays in state

slides.say: Arrays in state are read-only too. Every update passes a brand new array to the setter.
To add, spread the old items into a new array and put the new one at the end. To remove, filter out the item you do not want.
To change items, map. Return a new object for the item that changes, and the same item for the rest.

slides.text: Add: [...arr, x]. Remove: filter. Change: map.
slides.say: Takeaway: add with spread, remove with filter, change with map.
